records.title: LoopViT: Scaling Visual ARC with Looped Transformers
records.reason: LoopViT scales visual ARC by looping a vision transformer; this is a vision reasoning architecture and does not address LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Mem-T: Densifying Rewards for Long-Horizon Memory Agents
records.reason: Read the primary reward-densification method and evaluation. Mem-T is a training/reward method for long-horizon memory agents; its paper plots performance against inference cost, but its proposed change is reward shaping rather than an inference-cost mechanism, leaving only a weak indirect link to the agent-memory efficiency lineage.

records.title: Reuse your FLOPs: Scaling RL on Hard Problems by Conditioning on Very Off-Policy Prefixes
records.reason: PrefixRL improves sample efficiency of reinforcement-learning training by conditioning on off-policy prefixes; the primary abstract concerns training compute/reward, not deployment inference efficiency.

records.title: NextFlow: Unified Sequential Modeling Activates Multimodal Understanding and Generation
records.reason: Read the primary architecture and inference-efficiency analysis. NextFlow uses next-scale visual token generation to reduce image synthesis FLOPs/runtime, but the efficiency claim is for image generation in a multimodal vision model, not LLM language inference or serving.
